general.title: TextMeFlow - WhatsApp
general.description: Send WhatsApp order updates through TextMeFlow.

connect.title: Connect to TextMeFlow
connect.intro: Send your customers order updates on WhatsApp. Click the button, sign in or create a free TextMeFlow account, and approve the connection. You will return here automatically.
connect.privacy: Phone numbers and message texts are sent to TextMeFlow (EU-hosted, Fades Management EOOD, Bulgaria) to deliver the messages.
connect.tokenInvalid: The connection was removed in your TextMeFlow account. Please connect again.

pair.title: Link your WhatsApp
pair.instructions: Open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Settings, then Linked devices, tap Link a device and scan this code.
pair.deviceLimit: Your plan has no room for another WhatsApp number.
pair.error: The code could not be loaded. Please try again.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Choose which messages are sent and edit the texts. Customers only receive messages when they tick the WhatsApp checkbox at checkout.

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Stop sending messages and remove the connection from this shop.
disconnect.confirm: Messages will no longer be sent. Do you want to disconnect this shop from TextMeFlow?

notice.failed: Connecting did not work. Please try again.
notice.statusFailed: The status could not be loaded.
notice.httpsRequired: Connecting requires this shop to be reachable over https.
notice.invalidNumber: This phone number is not valid. Include the country code, for example +32470123456.
notice.testFailed: The test message could not be sent.
